summary: Improve board oversight of AI investment, risk, and assurance. Explore practical AI governance training and review the course outline.
lede: AI governance training for boards helps directors, committee members, and senior executives oversee AI investment and enterprise risk without taking over model development. Participants review AI portfolios and accountable ownership, assess risks and assurance evidence, and set oversight questions, escalation criteria, and board reporting. Exercises use portfolio inventories, risk-and-control assessments, and dashboard planning to connect AI decisions with strategy and risk appetite.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders who oversee AI investment, enterprise risk, technology strategy, or board assurance and need to challenge AI proposals without taking over operational model development.
modules: OECD AI Principles and Board Mandate
AI Incident Escalation and Third-Party Models
prerequisites: Working familiarity with board, executive, risk, or technology decision-making is expected. No coding or model-development experience is required.
